title: Structural Variety, Isomerism, and Interconversions of Polynuclear Samarium Complexes with Reduced 9,10-Phenanthrenequinone Ligand

material_class.structural_family: trinuclear catecholate; Sm3 triangle with an O6 trigonal-prismatic core capped by three SmCp* units

synthesis.procedure: Under argon/vacuum, phenQ (105 mg, 0.504 mmol) and [SmCp*2(thf)2] (285 mg, 0.504 mmol) were sealed in a bent two-section ampule with toluene (ca. 15 mL) condensed in under liquid-N2 cooling. The mixture turned dark green on warming to room temperature, then was heated at 80 °C for 24 h as the color changed to brownish orange. The solvent was transferred off, the brown oily residue was extracted in a temperature gradient, and the crystals were washed twice with small portions of cold toluene to remove Cp*2 and dried in vacuum. Orange blocks.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: evacuated sealed bent two-section ampule; vacuum condensation of solvent
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solvent transferred by cooling; extraction in a temperature gradient; crystals washed with cold toluene and dried in vacuum; isolated as the 1.5 toluene solvate

material_class.structural_family: binuclear bis(catecholate); one symmetrical O,O-bridge and one chelate-bridge, CN 8 at both Sm

synthesis.procedure: Under vacuum, phenQ (108 mg, 0.519 mmol) and [SmCp*2(thf)2] (295 mg, 0.522 mmol) were treated with condensed thf (15 mL). The mixture turned dark green at room temperature, then orange during 1 h at 60 °C; heating was continued for another hour. The solution was concentrated to ca. 1 mL, hexane (10 mL) was condensed onto the oily residue, and the yellow powder was kept at −30 °C for 1 h. The solution was removed by cannula filtration and the solid was dried in vacuum, then recrystallized from hexane (8 mL) and thf (2 mL) to give orange elongated crystals.
synthesis.time: about 2 h at 60 °C, then 1 h at −30 °C
synthesis.vessel_or_method: vacuum condensation into a reaction vessel; recrystallization in a two-section ampule
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: concentration, hexane precipitation, cannula filtration, vacuum drying, recrystallization from hexane/thf

material_class.structural_family: binuclear samarocene catecholate with a chelate-bridging phenCat and two {SmCp*2} units

synthesis.procedure: Under vacuum, phenQ (44 mg, 0.21 mmol) and desolvated [SmCp*2] (187 mg, 0.444 mmol) in toluene (10 mL) were stirred for 4 h and turned dark wine-red at room temperature. The solution was concentrated to 4 mL, evaporated to dryness in a bent two-section ampule, and extracted with hexane (10 mL). Raw 6 (145 mg, 63% for 6·0.5C6H14) crystallized with smaller amounts of 7a and an admixture of 4. Combined raw product (304 mg) recrystallized from hexane gave pure 6·0.5C6H14 (210 mg, 69%). A related 2:1 reaction of [SmCp*2(thf)2] (230 mg, 0.407 mmol) with phenQ (42 mg, 0.20 mmol) in toluene (15 mL, 8 h) also gave 6 as the main hexane-extraction product (113 mg, 52% for 6·0.5C6H14), with 4 and 7a.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature after warming from liquid-N2 condensation
synthesis.vessel_or_method: vacuum line and sealed bent two-section ampule
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: concentration, evaporation, hexane extraction; recrystallization from hexane. Also crystallizes from toluene as 6·PhMe
synthesis.yield: raw 145 mg (63% for 6·0.5C6H14); 210 mg (69%) after recrystallization of 304 mg combined raw product

material_class.structural_family: mixed-valence Sm(II)/Sm(III) trinuclear catecholate isomer; two SmCp* and one SmCp*2, quasi-C2 in the thf/hexane solvate

synthesis.procedure: Freshly obtained 5·1.5C6H14·thf (148 mg, 0.105 mmol) and [SmCp*2(thf)2] (63 mg, 0.11 mmol) were sealed with hexane (10 mL) and stirred at room temperature for 8 h, giving a swamp-brown precipitate under a brownish solution. Extraction in a temperature gradient for 3 days gave nearly complete recrystallization as black elongated crystals of 7a with greenish-brown square plates of 7b. The solution was decanted and the crystals were dried in vacuum. Combined yield 118 mg (80%). The thf/hexane solvate forms when thf is available from the starting samarocene; crystallization from hexane with base-free samarocene gives solvent-free 7a.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: temperature-gradient extraction from hexane; mixture of 7a and 7b crystals dried in vacuum

material_class.structural_family: double complex salt; binuclear catecholate anion 8- with a mononuclear samarocenium cation

synthesis.procedure: Analogous to the synthesis of 4, phenQ (22 mg, 0.11 mmol) and [SmCp*2(thf)2] (60 mg, 0.11 mmol) were sealed with hexane (ca. 10 mL). After warming to room temperature the dark-green mixture was stirred for 48 h, turning orange-brown with a green precipitate. The solution was decanted and concentrated to ca. 2 mL. After several days the wall deposit contained red blocks of 6 as the main product, yellow needles of [SmCp*2(thf)2][8], and dark-green plates of 7a, identified by XRD.
synthesis.time: 48 h, then several days of crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: decantation and concentration to ca. 2 mL; mixed crystals identified by single-crystal XRD

material_class.structural_family: Sm(II) center coordinated by two binuclear Sm(III) catecholate anions 8-

synthesis.procedure: Minor product of the 2:1 reaction of desolvated samarocene with phenQ in toluene. In the characterized procedure, phenQ (44 mg, 0.21 mmol) and [SmCp*2] (187 mg, 0.444 mmol) in toluene (10 mL) were stirred for 4 h at room temperature, then the residue was extracted with hexane (10 mL) in a sealed ampule. Small swamp-green parallelogram plates of 9·3C6H14 crystallized from hexane on the vessel walls and were identified by XRD. No separate yield is reported.

material_class.structural_family: double complex salt; K+ coordinated by two binuclear anions 8-, with a samarocenium countercation

synthesis.procedure: From the 2:1 reaction of [SmCp*2(thf)2] with phenQ in toluene. The quantified run used phenQ (42 mg, 0.20 mmol) and [SmCp*2(thf)2] (230 mg, 0.407 mmol) in toluene (15 mL) for 8 h, followed by evaporation and hexane extraction. Yellow blocks obtained after recrystallization of products from hexane–toluene (9:1 v/v) were identified as [SmCp*2(thf)2][K(Sm2Cp*3(phenCat)2)2]·5PhMe. The potassium source is not specified. No separate yield is given.
synthesis.time: 8 h reaction; recrystallization time not specified
synthesis.vessel_or_method: vacuum condensation; sealed ampule extraction; recrystallization from hexane–toluene 9:1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: evaporation, hexane treatment, recrystallization from hexane–toluene; yellow blocks identified by XRD

material_class.structural_family: binuclear μ-hydroxo catecholate cocrystallized 2:1 with tetranuclear complex 12

synthesis.procedure: Observed in at least two syntheses from reactions of samarocene with phenQ. In the quantified 2:1 procedure, phenQ (42 mg, 0.20 mmol) and [SmCp*2(thf)2] (230 mg, 0.407 mmol) in toluene (15 mL) were stirred for 8 h, evaporated, and treated with hexane. Recrystallization of a resultant mixture from hexane–thf gave orange elongated crystals of the cocrystal [11]2[12]·8C6H14. No separate yield is reported.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: evaporation and hexane extraction, then recrystallization from hexane–thf; orange elongated crystals of the cocrystal

material_class.structural_family: neutral tetranuclear Sm(III) catecholate cocrystallized 1:2 with binuclear complex 11; same 1:1:1 Sm:Cp*:phenCat ratio as 4 but a different aggregate

synthesis.procedure: Cocrystallized with 11. In the quantified procedure, phenQ (42 mg, 0.20 mmol) and [SmCp*2(thf)2] (230 mg, 0.407 mmol) were stirred in toluene (15 mL) for 8 h, the mixture was evaporated, and the solid was taken up in hexane (15 mL). Recrystallization from hexane–thf produced orange elongated crystals of [11]2[12]·8C6H14. The light-orange color and C–O/C–C metrics were used to assign all dioxolenes as catecholates and 12 as neutral Sm(III). No separate yield is reported.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: evaporation, hexane extraction, recrystallization from hexane–thf as the [11]2[12] cocrystal
